task_description: Build a complete Government Exam Notification + Mock Test + Blog website using PHP 8.2, MySQL, and vanilla JS. Compatible with cPanel shared hosting (no Docker, no Node.js, no Composer). Beautiful UI/UX with Bootstrap 5 + custom CSS, Inter font via CDN. All API keys in MySQL settings table. Full admin panel with test-connection buttons, PayU payment, Gemini AI question generation, Telegram notifications, SMTP email via bundled PHPMailer.
